label: common_2140_announce_01
text:
There’s one last match in this tournament, ladies
and gentlemen...\c
Allow me to introduce the two Trainers who’ll
be facing off to finally determine who’s strongest
in the academy!

label: common_2140_announce_03
text: a special guest joining our tournament, the Top\nChampion, Geeta!

label: common_2140_top_02
text: I had a feeling I would meet you in the finals.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2140_top_04
text: Such a clash is what captures the crowd...and\nmakes their hearts race.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2140_top_05
text: This is extremely close to what I would call my\nideal world.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2140_top_06
text: As the chairperson for both the Pokémon League\nand the academy...[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2140_top_07
text: I find this situation to be incredibly satisfying.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2140_top_08
text: Now, if we both push each other to greater\nheights, we will achieve greater synergy.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2140_top_10
text: Let me show you the full might of the Top\nChampion![VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2140_announce_04
text: U-unbelievable, ladies and gentlemen...\nThe victor of this tournament...

label: common_2140_announce_05
text: and thus the strongest Trainer in the whole\nacademy is...Champion [VAR 0x0100(0000)]!

label: common_2140_rival_01
text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]! You did it! You DID it![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
